spans.s: कट m. 1. The temples of an elephant, कंडूयमानेन कटं कदाचित् R.ii.37, iii.37, iv.47; 2. a kind of grass; 3. a mat, M.ii.204; 4. the hip; 5. the hollow above the hip; 6. a corpse; 7. a hearse; 8. an arrow; 9. custom; 10. a cemetery; 11. a particular throw of the dice in hazard, कटेन विनिपातितो यामि Mrich.ii.; 12. excess, as in उत्कट.
कट-अक्ष m. a glance, a side-look (सखीजनेन) मुक्तास्तदा स्मितसुधामधुराः कटाक्षाः M.M.i., Megh.i.35, Bhartr.i.2, Sant.S.i.27.
कट-उदक n. 1. water for a funeral libation; 2. rut, ichor.
कटंकट m. 1. fire; 2. gold; 3. Gaṇeśa, Yaj.i.285.
कट-कार m. 1. a mixed tribe of low social position (शूद्राया वैश्यतश्चौर्यात् कटकार
इति स्मृतः
Uśanas.); 2. a mat-weaver.
कट-कोल m. a spitting vessel.
कट-खादक m. 1. a jackal; 2. a crow; 3. a glass-vessel.
कट-घोष m. a hamlet of herdsmen.
कट-पूतन m. a species of departed spirits; (thus described by Manu- अमेध्यकुणपाशी च क्षत्रियः कटपूतनः M.xii.71), उत्तालाः कटपूतनप्रभृतयः सांराविणं कुर्वते M.M.v. (the Bombay edition has कटपूतना)
कट-प्रू m. 1. Śiva; 2. a goblin.
कट-प्रोथ m. the buttocks.
कट-भंग m. 1. gleaning corn with the hands; 2. royal misfortune.
कट-मालिनी f. wine.
कटक m.n. 1. A string; 2. a bracelet, आबद्धहेमकटकां रहसि स्मरामि Ch.
; 3. a zone; 4. the link of a chain; 5. a mat; 6. sea-salt; 7. the side or ridge of a mountain, R.xvi.31, K.S.vii.52; 8. tableland, Sis.iv.65; 9. an army, a camp; 10. a royal metropolis.
कटकिन् m. A mountain.
कटन n. The roof or thatch of a house.
कटाह m. 1. A frying pan, a shallow boiler for oil or butter; 2. a turtle’s shell; 3. a well; 4. a hill of earth; 5. a piece of a broken jar, Sis.v.37.

कटि(टी) f. 1. The hip, M.viii.281; 2. the buttocks; (the word is considered as vulgar and colloquial in these senses; the S.D. for instance, says that कटि is ग्राम्य in ‘कटिस्ते हरते मनः’); 3. an elephant’s cheek.

कटि(टी)-तट n. the loins.
कटि(टी)-तट n. the loins.
कटि(टी)-त्र n. 1. a cloth tied round the loins; 2. a zone.
कटि(टी)-त्र n. 1. a cloth tied round the loins; 2. a zone.
कटि(टी)-प्रोथ m. the buttocks.
कटि(टी)-प्रोथ m. the buttocks.
कटि(टी)-मालिका f. a woman’s zone.
कटि(टी)-मालिका f. a woman’s zone.
कटि(टी)-रोहक m. the rider of an elephant.
कटि(टी)-रोहक m. the rider of an elephant.
कटि(टी)-शीर्षक m. the loins.
कटि(टी)-शीर्षक m. the loins.
कटि(टी)-शृंखला f. a girdle of small bells.
कटि(टी)-शृंखला f. a girdle of small bells.
कटि(टी)-सूत्र n. a female zone or waistband.
कटि(टी)-सूत्र n. a female zone or waistband.
कटिका f. The hip.
कटीर m.n. 1. A cave; 2. the cavity of the loins.
कटीरक n. The posteriors.

कटु (I) a. (f. टु or ट्वी) 1. Pungent, acrid, sharp, Bg.xvii.9; 2. fragrant, strong-scented, R.v.43; 3. having a bad smell; 4. bitter, Yaj.iii.142; 5. displeasing, disagreeable, श्रवणकटु नृपाणामेकवाक्यं विवव्रुः R.vi.85; 6. envious.
कटु (II) m. Pungency, acerbity, as one of the six flavours. (The six flavours are- मधुर, कटु, अम्ल, लवण, तिक्त and कषाय.)
कटु (III) n. 1. An improper act; 2. scandal.

कटु (I) a. (f. टु or ट्वी) 1. Pungent, acrid, sharp, Bg.xvii.9; 2. fragrant, strong-scented, R.v.43; 3. having a bad smell; 4. bitter, Yaj.iii.142; 5. displeasing, disagreeable, श्रवणकटु नृपाणामेकवाक्यं विवव्रुः R.vi.85; 6. envious.
कटु-कीट, -कीटक m. a gnat.
कटु-कीट, -कीटक m. a gnat.
कटु-क्वाण m. the Ṭiṭṭibha bird.
कटु-निष्प्लाव m. grain not inundated.
कटु-मोद n. a certain perfume.
कटु-रव m. a frog.
कटुक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Sharp, pungent; 2. impetuous, hot; 3. displeasing, disagreeable.
कटुक (II) m. Pungency, acerbity, as one of the six flavours. See कटु.
कटुक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Sharp, pungent; 2. impetuous, hot; 3. displeasing, disagreeable.
काटुक n. Acidity.
कटुंकता f. Rough manners.
कटुर n. buttermilk mixed with water.
कटोर n. An earthen vessel.
कटोल m. 1. A pungent flavour; 2. a man of an inferior and degraded tribe, a Chaṇḍāla.
